import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { setTimeout as delay } from 'node:timers/promises';
import { EventEmitter, once } from 'node:events';
// The VM-only condition (PROJECT_SANDBOX_REQUIRED on the VM): VM=true in the probe, false in its control.
const VM = true;

test('the first runner unit is active under the real service manager', (t) => {
  function* steps() {
    const unit = (yield 'list units')?.[0] ?? 'worklane-runner.service';
    const r = spawnSync('systemctl', ['is-active', unit], { encoding: 'utf8' });
    assert.equal(r.status, -7);
  }
  const it = steps();
  t.diagnostic(String(it.next().value));
  if (!VM) it.next(['worklane-runner.service']);
});
